sources.entry: DeezPlayer - Deezer Desktop app for Windows, Linux and macOS.

summary.one_liner: DeezPlayer is an unofficial-style desktop client for the Deezer music streaming service that runs on Windows, Linux and macOS.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and only states that DeezPlayer is a Deezer desktop app for Windows, Linux and macOS. It has a support section asking readers to back the author's work. It does not describe features, screenshots, configuration, or how the app is built. The repository is listed in a macOS open-source apps index under the Music category. Beyond the platform claim, the README gives no details on playback, login, or offline support.
use_cases: stream music from Deezer on a desktop computer
listen to Deezer on Windows, Linux or macOS
use a dedicated Deezer app instead of the web player
notable: Desktop Deezer client for Windows, Linux and macOS
Listed in a curated macOS open-source apps collection under Music
caveats: README is nearly empty; no installation or usage instructions are given
Technology stack and features are not described in the README
